title: LTFRB approves permits for 20 buses to augment LRT-2 services

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has approved special permits for 20 buses to serve two routes between Antipolo City, Rizal, and Metro Manila as part of efforts to ease congestion among Light Rail Transit Line 2 (LRT-2) commuters. The buses will serve the Antipolo-Legarda route in Manila and the Antipolo-Cubao route in Quezon City, with half of the fleet also assigned to augment LRT-2 services from its Antipolo Station in Masinag. LTFRB Acting Chair Greg Pua said the permits were issued in response to the Department of Transportation’s (DOTr) initiative to provide additional public transportation […]...
